title: Output aggregation
statement: For optional Boolean outputs $o_1,o_2\in\operatorname{Option}(\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\})$, define their aggregate to be $o_1$ if $o_2$ is absent, to be $o_2$ if $o_1$ is absent, and to be the present value $\mathrm{false}$ if both are present.
